text_block_list.name: Cooking-Lover Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! I made food in the kitchen, and 
ended up with way more than expected! Have 
some if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Waah~ Looks delicious! Can I take a 
picture? Of the food, and the person who 
made it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, the storage capacity is full!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I guess I have to delete one of them... 
Ugh, I can't choose~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion felt a little down after 
failing to preserve the memory...
